title: console record form: a create/edit dialog with no authored layout opens at 95vw with one column of unequal field widths — a bounded dialog with a two-column field grid and one width per field kind
body:
Filing gate ① (a user-visible layout defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F3, figure 5), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/plugin-form` (`ModalForm.tsx`, `FormSection.tsx`) with the console's form host in `@object-ui/app-shell` if the size is chosen there, size M.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "create record form dialog too wide single column fields inconsistent widths two column grid modal form layout" → 20, top 8 read: #12480 (open, the Studio Records grid's row gap), #11903 (the record picker's one layout), #11775 (the drawer's direction), #11542, #10563, #12080 (a screen flow's fixed 448 px dialog, the sibling ruling: a dialog's width follows its content), #4755, #4574 (closed). None is this card.

## What happens

On the HotCRM Leads list at 1440 × 900, New opens "Create Lead" as a dialog of 1368 × 810 px (95 % of the viewport each way) whose content is 1099 px tall, so it scrolls. Inside, fourteen fields stand in a single column: most text inputs are 841 px wide, Last Name alone spans 1270 px, the selects are 413 px, and the right third of the dialog is empty. The phone form (390) is a full-screen sheet with one column and stacked Cancel / Create, which is the right shape there.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` lines 258–266: the size map `sm` → `sm:max-w-sm`, `default` → `sm:max-w-lg`, `lg` → `sm:max-w-2xl`, `xl` → `sm:max-w-5xl`, `full` → `sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full`; line 391: the size auto-upgrades when auto-layout infers multiple columns and the author set none. The measured dialog is the `full` width.
2. `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` line 3014 reads the authored `size` (`'auto' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full'`) for the form the list opens.
3. `packages/plugin-form/src/FormSection.tsx` lines 72–89: a section's `columns` is `1 | 2 | 3 | 4` and sets the field grid; `packages/types/src/form.ts` lines 1911–1923 and 2401: `FormField.colSpan` / `span: 'auto' | 'full'` and the form's `columns`, aligned with `@objectstack/spec` `FormField`.
4. Browser reading (1440): input widths 841 (first_name, company, title, email, phone, mobile, website), 1270 (last_name), 413 (the selects, estimated_amount); fourteen controls; dialog 1368 × 810, scroll height 1099.

So the keys exist (section `columns`, field `colSpan` / `span`, dialog `size`); what the console renders by default for an object form with no authored layout is the widest dialog and one column with per-kind widths.

## What to build

1. The default dialog for a create/edit form that declares no `size` is bounded (`lg` or `xl` of the existing map, chosen by the field count and the inferred columns, never `full`); `full` stays available to an author who asks for it. The auto-upgrade at line 391 picks within that bound.
2. The default field grid for a section with no authored `columns` is two columns from `md` up (the spec's own `columns` / `colSpan` path, so an authored layout still wins); a `textarea`, a rich text, a line-items panel and a field with `span: 'full'` take the whole row; every other field takes one cell, so same-kind fields have one width.
3. Required markers, labels, help text and the footer unchanged; the phone sheet unchanged.

## Acceptance

- `ModalForm` / `FormSection` tests: an object form with twelve fields and no authored layout renders a dialog with the `lg` or `xl` class (not `sm:max-w-[95vw]`), a two-column grid from `md` up, a `textarea` spanning both columns; an authored `size: 'full'` and an authored `columns: 1` are honoured as written; below `sm` the sheet is one column.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on HotCRM Leads → New: the dialog is no wider than the `xl` bound, the fields sit in two columns of one width each, nothing scrolls for the first eight fields.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (minor) for `@object-ui/plugin-form` (and `@object-ui/app-shell` if touched).

## Out of scope

- Authored HotCRM form layouts (the demo's forms are generated); a side-sheet variant; field ordering.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
